pages.title: End Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Appears above the End return portal after defeating the Ender Dragon.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)Active while held, embedded in worn armor, or in a Curios slot: creative flight; single-hit damage capped at 10, then reduced by 80%; every 10 experience levels grants +100% damage dealt, up to +1000%; immunity to mining penalties and slowness; End mobs become neutral. Below Y=-60, a 3-second void rescue returns you to your respawn point; at Y≤-40, void damage is blocked.$(br2)Maids gain the same damage bonus from their own experience.
